notes.title: Great Update!!!
notes.notes:
Finally, our update is ready!

We've been through a lot of difficulties, and right now we're ready to introduce new mini-game mechanics to our game!

A button to enter the game room has appeared on the main menu of the game. There are three slots machines. Each one is a mini-game where you can earn tickets that you can exchange for valuable rewards later. You can receive 4 random boxes daily and other items from the ticket shop in unlimited quantities.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/bMyWX1WJ/playground.png[/img]

In addition, we are finally updating the regular item drop box. The Primitive Set will take the place of the Gamer Set:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/SXPzz8d0/primitive.png[/img]

The Steam item store has also been updated. [b]Rich Set[/b] has been expanded:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/whV6wyqS/1.png[/img]

 Abstract Art Set also appeared:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/N2ZJypms/image.png[/img]

Other changes have also been introduced:
[list]
[*]The transition to the new version of the game engine has been completed
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Steam Cloud save to be deleted
[*]Fixed the display of inventory icons
[*]Fixed an issue with objects reflecting
[*]Other changes
[/list]

We are continuing to work on the game, and we hope that we will be able to update it more regularly.

Thank you for continuing to play Cashrooms!

notes.title: Valentine's Day Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Valentine's Day[/b] to everyone. On this day, we want to send you our [b]valentines[/b] :D. Open the game soon to get it!

[b]Some new features[/b] are also being tested in this update. Here is a list of these features that you can try out right now:
[list]
[*] The ability to reflect the subject in the building mode.
[*] Accelerate the opening of the case by pressing the left mouse button.
[*] Notification with information about the dropped item.
[*] Improve the music player.
[/list]

We are currently working on a major game update that will bring both new activities and new ways to get items. So be ready for game update, new boxes, and changes to the in-game store soon.
Thank you for continuing to play Cashrooms.

notes.title: New Patch
notes.notes:
Finally, a new update!

It's time to say goodbye to the drop of old sets, because today we are ready to present a new set!
Please love and favor: [b]Gamer Set[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/9Y7yk3m/image.png[/img]
A number of bugs have also been fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect display of "Garage Set Pegboard" and "Garage Set Trophy Shelf".
[*] Fixed the sorting interface at lower resolutions.
[*] Eliminated the possibility of stacking items at a point after selecting from the inventory.
[*] Fixed the "Soviet New Year Set Garland" animation.
[/list]

We also want to announce that we are developing a major update that will introduce new activities to the game, as well as a new way to receive drops! 
Stay tuned so you don't miss anything!

notes.title: Item Drop Changes
notes.notes:
-Exclusive Release Cake doesn't drop anymore.

Be proud if you own one of them.

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
We have finally come out and are ready to show you all the game features we have described.

In the first days after the game's release, the promo item "Exclusive Cake" will be given out! In addition, starting today, a box is available in the regular drop, which includes the release set "NoHead Set". 

We will continue to delight you with constant updates, which will contain new sets and items, as well as new game features and features.

Come in now so you don't miss anything!
